```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtext)
library(latex2exp)
```

```{r}

v_vals <- seq(-50, 50, length.out = 2001) 
dv <- diff(v_vals)[1] 

mu_vals <- seq(-30, 30, length.out = 201)
trunc_mu_vals <- seq(-10, 10, length.out = 21)
dMu <- diff(mu_vals)[1]

sigma_vals <- seq(1, 5, length.out = 10)
dSigma <- diff(sigma_vals)[1]
```

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=3}

priors <- list(list(-8, 1), list(-6, 1.5), list(-2, 2), list(0, 3), list(2, 2), list(6, 1.5), list(8,1))
df_priors <- do.call(rbind, lapply(priors, function(p)
    data.frame(V = v_vals, P = dnorm(v_vals, p[[1]], p[[2]]), mu = factor(p[[1]]), sigma = factor(p[[2]]))
)) %>% filter(V >-15 & V< 15)


ggplot(df_priors, aes(x = V, y = P, color = mu, fill=mu)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_area(alpha = 0.1, position = "identity") +
    labs(x = "v", y = expression(pi(v))) +
    theme_bw()
```

```{r}

prior_L0 <- function(mu, sigma) {
  dnorm(v_vals, mu, sigma) 
}

likelihood <- function(x) {
  exp(0.5* x)
}

likelihood_L0 <- function(R) {
  if(R == "null") rep(1, length(v_vals)) else likelihood(v_vals)
}

```

```{r}

evidential <- function(mu, sigma, R) {
  prior <- prior_L0(mu, sigma)
  likelihood <- likelihood_L0(R)
  unnorm_posterior <- prior * likelihood
  norm <- sum(unnorm_posterior) * dv
  posterior <- unnorm_posterior / norm
  data.frame(V = v_vals, 
             Prior = prior, 
             Posterior = posterior,
             UnnormPosterior = unnorm_posterior,
             mu = mu, 
             sigma = sigma, 
             R = R)
}
```

```{r}
priors <- list(list(-10, 3), list(0, 3), list(8, 3))

figure1_data <- lapply(priors, function(prior) {
    evidential(prior[[1]], prior[[2]], "long")
  }) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Prior", "Posterior"),
               names_to = "Distribution",
               values_to = "Prob")

posterior_means <- figure1_data %>%
  filter(Distribution == "Posterior") %>%
  group_by(mu) %>%
  summarise(post_mean = sum(V * Prob) * dv, .groups = "drop")

ggplot(figure1_data,aes(x = V, y = Prob, fill = Distribution, color = Distribution)) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.1, position = "identity") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mu),
             linetype = "dashed",
             color = "gray50",
             linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(data = posterior_means,
             aes(xintercept = post_mean),
             linetype = "dashed",
             color = "blue",
             linewidth = 0.5) +
 facet_wrap(
  ~ mu,
  labeller = as_labeller(
    function(x) paste0("mu == ", x),
    default = label_parsed
  ),
  ncol=1
)+
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Utterance", 
                    values = c("Prior" = "gray50", "Posterior" = "blue"),
                    labels = c("Prior" = "null (R=0)", "Posterior" = "long (R=4)")) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Utterance", 
                     values = c("Prior" = "gray50", "Posterior" = "blue"),
                     labels = c("Prior" = "null (R=0)", "Posterior" = "long (R=4)")) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Bayesian update with no pragmatic reasoning",
    x = "v",
    y = expression(paste(P[L[0]^list(mu, sigma)], "(v|R)"))
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-18, 18)) +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16)
  )

```

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=3}

evid_data <- evidential(5, 2, "long")

mean_vline <- data.frame(
  Distribution = c("OriginalPrior", "InferredPrior", "Posterior"),
  mean = c(5,                                          
           5,                                    
           sum(v_vals * evid_data$Posterior * dv))      
)

evid_data <- evid_data %>%
  mutate(OriginalPrior = Prior, InferredPrior = Prior) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("OriginalPrior", "InferredPrior", "Posterior"),
               names_to = "Distribution",
                 values_to = "Prob") %>%
  filter(V>-10, V<10) 

labels_evid <- c(
  "OriginalPrior" = TeX("Original Prior: $p_{L_0^\\pi}(v)=\\pi(v)$"),
  "InferredPrior" = TeX("Inferred Prior: $p_{L_0^\\pi}(v)=\\pi(v)$"),
  "Posterior"     = TeX("Posterior: $p_{L_0^\\pi}(v|u=R)$")
)

ggplot(evid_data, aes(x = V, y = Prob, fill = Distribution, color = Distribution, linetype = Distribution, group=Distribution)) +

    values = c("OriginalPrior" = "dashed", "InferredPrior" = "solid", "Posterior" = "solid"),
```

```{r}

L0_array_null <- array(
  vapply(seq_along(sigma_vals), function(k)
    vapply(seq_along(mu_vals), function(j)
      evidential(mu_vals[j], sigma_vals[k], "null")$Posterior,
      numeric(length(v_vals))),
    numeric(length(v_vals) * length(mu_vals))),
  dim = c(length(v_vals), length(mu_vals), length(sigma_vals))
)

L0_array_long <- array(
  vapply(seq_along(sigma_vals), function(k)
    vapply(seq_along(mu_vals), function(j)
      evidential(mu_vals[j], sigma_vals[k], "long")$Posterior,
      numeric(length(v_vals))),
    numeric(length(v_vals) * length(mu_vals))),
  dim = c(length(v_vals), length(mu_vals), length(sigma_vals))
)
```

```{r}

theta_vals <- seq(0, 5, length.out = 6)
dTheta <- diff(theta_vals)[1]
cost <- c(null = 0, long = 1.5) 
alpha = 1

speaker_grid <- expand.grid(
  theta_i = 1:length(theta_vals),
  mu_j = 1:length(mu_vals),
  sigma_k = 1:length(sigma_vals)
)
speaker_grid$theta <- theta_vals[speaker_grid$theta_i]
speaker_grid$mu <- mu_vals[speaker_grid$mu_j]
speaker_grid$sigma <- sigma_vals[speaker_grid$sigma_k]

s_probs <- mapply(function(i, j, k) {
  
  #surprisal
  surprisal_null <- -log(sum(L0_array_null[v_vals > theta_vals[i], j, k]) * dv)
  surprisal_long <- -log(sum(L0_array_long[v_vals > theta_vals[i], j, k]) * dv)
  
  #informativity
  inf_null <- -surprisal_null
  inf_long <- -surprisal_long
  
  #utility
  util_null <- inf_null - cost["null"]
  util_long <- inf_long - cost["long"]
  
  #softmax
  null_numer <- exp(alpha * util_null)
  long_numer <- exp(alpha * util_long)
  denom <- null_numer + long_numer
  prob_null <- null_numer/denom
  prob_long <- long_numer/denom
  
  c(surprisal_null, surprisal_long, util_null, util_long, prob_null, prob_long)
}, speaker_grid$theta_i, speaker_grid$mu_j, speaker_grid$sigma_k)

speaker_grid$surprisal_null <- s_probs[1,]
speaker_grid$surprisal_long <- s_probs[2,]
speaker_grid$util_null <- s_probs[3,]
speaker_grid$util_long <- s_probs[4,]
speaker_grid$prob_null <- s_probs[5,]
speaker_grid$prob_long <- s_probs[6,]
```

```{r}

speaker_heatmap <- speaker_grid %>%
  mutate(surprisal_diff = surprisal_long - surprisal_null) %>%
  mutate(util_diff = util_long - util_null) %>%
  mutate(prob_diff = prob_long - prob_null) %>%
  filter(theta == 5) %>%
  filter(mu>-10, mu<10)

ggplot(speaker_heatmap, aes(x = mu, y = sigma, fill = surprisal_diff)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    high = "red", mid = "white", low = "blue", midpoint = 0,
    breaks = c(min(speaker_heatmap$surprisal_diff), 0, max(speaker_heatmap$surprisal_diff)),
    labels = c(expression(paste(Delta, " surprisal ->", infinity)), "", expression(paste(Delta, " surprisal = 0")))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = expression(paste(L[0]^list(mu, sigma), " post-utterance surprisal difference (long-null)")),
    subtitle = "How much do the reasons reduce the listener's surprisal?",
    x = expression(mu), y = expression(sigma), fill = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}

ggplot(speaker_heatmap, aes(x = mu, y = sigma, fill = util_diff)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    high = "blue", mid = "white", low = "red", midpoint = 0,
    breaks = c(min(speaker_heatmap$util_diff), 0, max(speaker_heatmap$util_diff)),
    labels = c("Prefers none", "", "Prefers reasons")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression(mu), y = expression(sigma), fill = ""
  ) +

```

```{r}

joint_grid <- speaker_grid

hyperprior_mu <- dnorm(mu_vals, 5, 10)
hyperprior_mu <- hyperprior_mu / (sum(hyperprior_mu) * dMu)
p_mu <- hyperprior_mu[joint_grid$mu_j]


hyperprior_sigma = rep(1, length(sigma_vals))
hyperprior_sigma <- hyperprior_sigma/ (sum(hyperprior_sigma) * dSigma)
p_sigma <- hyperprior_sigma[joint_grid$sigma_k]


prior_theta <- dnorm(theta_vals, 2, 2) 
prior_theta <- prior_theta/ (sum(prior_theta) * dTheta)
p_theta <- prior_theta[joint_grid$theta_i]

joint_grid <- joint_grid %>%
  mutate(joint_null = prob_null * p_theta * p_mu * p_sigma,
         joint_long = prob_long * p_theta * p_mu * p_sigma) %>%
  mutate(joint_null_norm = joint_null / (sum(joint_null) * dTheta * dMu * dSigma),
          joint_long_norm = joint_long / (sum(joint_long) * dTheta * dMu * dSigma))

marginal_grid <- joint_grid %>%
    group_by(mu_j, mu, sigma_k, sigma) %>%
    summarise(
      marg_null = sum(joint_null_norm) * dTheta,
      marg_long = sum(joint_long_norm) * dTheta,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>% arrange(sigma_k, mu_j)
  
```

```{r}
L1_prior_heatmap <- marginal_grid %>%
  filter(mu>-10 & mu<10)

ggplot(L1_prior_heatmap, aes(x = mu, y = sigma, fill = marg_null)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "white", high = "blue", limits = c(min(L1_prior_heatmap$marg_null), max(L1_prior_heatmap$marg_null)),
    name = expression(paste(P[L[1]], "(" , pi[list(mu, sigma)], "|R=null)")),
    labels = scales::scientific
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Pragmatic listener inferred prior from null utterance",
    x = expression(mu), y = expression(sigma), fill = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw()

ggplot(L1_prior_heatmap, aes(x = mu, y = sigma, fill = marg_long)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "white", high = "blue", limits = c(min(L1_prior_heatmap$marg_long), max(L1_prior_heatmap$marg_long)),
    name = expression(paste(P[L[1]], "(" , pi, "|u=R)")),
    labels = scales::scientific
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Pragmatic listener inferred prior from u=R",
    x = expression(mu), y = expression(sigma), fill = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}

inferred_priors <- marginal_grid %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(marg_null, marg_long),
               names_to = "Utterance",
               values_to = "Prob") %>%
  group_by(Utterance) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_mu    = weighted.mean(mu, Prob),
    avg_sigma = weighted.mean(sigma, Prob)
  )

null_mu    <- inferred_priors$avg_mu[inferred_priors$Utterance == "marg_null"]
null_sigma <- inferred_priors$avg_sigma[inferred_priors$Utterance == "marg_null"]
long_mu    <- inferred_priors$avg_mu[inferred_priors$Utterance == "marg_long"]
long_sigma <- inferred_priors$avg_sigma[inferred_priors$Utterance == "marg_long"]
```

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=3}
posterior <- evidential(long_mu, long_sigma, "long")$Posterior

prag_data <- data.frame(
  v = v_vals,
  OriginalPrior = dnorm(v_vals, 5,2),
  InferredPrior = dnorm(v_vals, long_mu, long_sigma),
  Posterior = posterior
) %>%
pivot_longer(cols = c("OriginalPrior", "InferredPrior", "Posterior"),
               names_to = "Distribution",
                 values_to = "Prob")

mean_vline <- data.frame(
  Distribution = c("OriginalPrior", "InferredPrior", "Posterior"),
  mean = c(5,                                          
           long_mu,                                    
           sum(v_vals * posterior * dv))      
)

prag_data <- prag_data %>% filter(v<10, v>-10)

labels_prag <- c(
  "OriginalPrior" = TeX("Original Prior: $p_{L_1}(v)$"),
  "InferredPrior" = TeX("Inferred Prior: $\\pi(v)$"),
  "Posterior"     = TeX("Posterior: $p_{L_1}(v|u=R)$")
)


ggplot(prag_data, aes(x = v, y = Prob, fill = Distribution, color = Distribution, linetype = Distribution, group=Distribution)) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.1, position = "identity") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("OriginalPrior" = "solid", "InferredPrior" = "solid", "Posterior" = "solid"),
    labels = labels_prag) +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_vline(data = mean_vline, aes(xintercept = mean, color = Distribution),
             linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("OriginalPrior" = "#619CFF", "InferredPrior" = "#F8766D", "Posterior" =  "#00BA38"), 
    labels = labels_prag) +
  scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("OriginalPrior" = "#619CFF", "InferredPrior" = "#F8766D", "Posterior" =  "#00BA38"),
      labels = labels_prag) +
  labs(x = "v", y = "Probability density") +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.15, 0.75))
```
